2) Most popular sightseeing place in Miami, presumably with kids-friendly? The second request says "find out the most popular sightseeing place in Miami". There's no mention of kids friendliness but we can assume default True as per function signature. But maybe they'd like just the most popular one regardless of kid-friendliness. However the function has parameter kidsFriendly optional default true. We could set it false to get general popularity. But likely they want the most popular overall. So call with kidsFriendly=false perhaps.

We need to use the tool calls. We'll first call supermarket_find_in_city with city="Los Angeles", state="California" and openNow=true. Then call sightseeing_popular_in_city with city="Miami", state="Florida" and kidsFriendly=false.
